etymologies.etymologyHTML: From some +‎ body.

quote.citation: 1974, United States. Congress. House. Committee on Agriculture, Agriculture and the Fuel Crisis: Hearings..., page 88:
quote.text: So there, I know, was somebody or a combination of somebodys who did not know what the heck they were doing or dealing with.

definitions.definition: A recognised or important person, a celebrity.
